# homarr_user (List Resource)

Lists the Homarr users that `homarr_user` can manage — those that sign in with credentials — for `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later), sorted by username and then id. Accounts backed by LDAP or OIDC are left out, because `homarr_user` refuses to import them; `homarr_user_preferences` manages those, and the `homarr_users` data source lists them. Each result is named after the username and carries the user's identity, ready for an `import` block.

Listing works with any API key. With `include_resource = true` every user is also read the way Terraform reads one after importing it, which takes two requests per user and an admin key, as `homarr_user` itself does. The password is never readable, so it is always null. The list takes no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or newer. Only accounts that sign in with
# a Homarr password are listed, because homarr_user manages no others.
list "homarr_user" "all" {
  provider = homarr
}

# Reading each user in full needs an admin key and two requests per user. The
# password is never readable, so generated configuration must add it.
list "homarr_user" "detailed" {
  provider         = homarr
  include_resource = true
}
```
